notes.title: Last Outpost v1.0 Out Now!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello Survivors[/b][/h3][p]The official [b]full version of Last Outpost[/b] is released now! 🎉[/p][p]The game price will remain the same and to celebrate the launch you can grab it with a [b]20% discount[/b] for a limited time![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Roadmap is Completed![/b][/h3][p]The roadmap is finally complete! [b]Released on February 27.[/b] Thanks to all of your feedback and suggestions during Early Access, we’ve been able to shape the future of Last Outpost more clearly.[/p][h3]👉 You can check out the full Roadmap Update here: [b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2927780/view/526462108129297577?l=english"]Roadmap Update[/url][/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]What’s New in v1.0?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Doomwalk Valley:[/b] the ultimate final level, featuring both land and water combat together.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Water Vehicle: Jetski[/b], equipped with its own unique [b]Torpedo Shot[/b] ability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Epic Boss Fight:[/b] face the [i][b]Walking Bastion of Doom[/b][/i], a moving fortress unlike anything before.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Tutorial:[/b] A fully renewed main tutorial plus in-game tutorials to guide you as you play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Balance & Performance:[/b] Refined unit behavior, tougher heroes, faster transitions and smarter wave design.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes & Quality of Life:[/b] Clearer settings, improved UI and many fixes for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p]and more...[/p][h3]👉 You can check out the detailed [b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2927780/view/526478592467534528?l=english"]v1.0 Update Notes[/url][/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Thank You![/b][/h3][p]I couldn’t have reached this point without your support during Early Access. Every bit of feedback helped shape the game into what it is today.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Good luck out there, Raiders. I hope you enjoy the full release![/b][/p][p][/p][p]-Kemal[/p]

notes.title: Last Outpost Full Release Update Notes! (v1.0.0)
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello Survivors[/b][/h3][p]Last Outpost is finally leaving the early access with new content and more! Let's look at what's new and what changed.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Doomwalk Valley[/b][/h2][p]Doomwalk Valley is the final level of the game, bringing together ground and water vehicles in one stage for new challenges and strategies. A new vehicle, the [b]Jetski[/b] is introduced exclusively for this level. The Jetski comes with its own unique ability, [b]Torpedo Shot[/b], making it a powerful but level-specific addition available only in Doomwalk Valley.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/b3a0ec066044caa7e7e7dba76d5235e09ed2b8da.png"][/img][/p][p]This level also features a unique boss fight, prepare to face the [b]Walking Bastion of Doom[/b], a massive moving fortress equipped with powerful abilities that will test all of your skills.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Renewed Menu Art[/b][/h2][p]A brand new main menu has been designed by a professional pixel artist. I’m very happy with how it turned out but I’d love to hear your thoughts in the comments![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/311d08e415b5670939a980a18328d9efa94b7f72.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]In Game Tutorials[/b][/h2][p]Tutorials now continue during gameplay. Mechanics are explained when needed, helping you to learn step by step. This feature can be disabled in the settings for experienced players.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay & Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Borders of the map[/b] are now visible with dedicated particle effects, making it easier to see the playable area.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sniper units[/b] now distribute their fire more intelligently, avoiding over-focusing on a single target.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial has been fully redesigned with improved visuals and updated tasks. It now explains mechanics in greater detail, making the introduction clearer and more helpful for new players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Strong Leadership[/b] perk fixed. units can now attack while moving under command, making them far more effective.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Volt Guard Tower HP[/b] adjusted: 1200 → 900.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 2 Towers[/b] HP increased by 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Building placements adjusted for better combat efficiency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Motorcycle Sidecar damage[/b] increased: 10 → 12.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All building HP[/b] increased by ~10–20% based on feedback, making them feel sturdier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hero units[/b] are now tougher. Their [b]HP[/b] and [b]damage[/b] have been increased to make them stand out from regular units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactical Emplacement[/b] building improved: more efficient and resistant to enemy attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Scene transitions are now significantly faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Wave balancing adjusted across all levels to match new gameplay changes.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Settings menu redesigned with clearer visuals and options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a tutorial bug where skipping a task caused errors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tech Tree popup[/b] positioning corrected for different resolutions, no more off-screen popups.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor localization mistakes corrected in several languages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vehicled Car rotation speed[/b] fixed (improved controls).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Building placement slider[/b] now uses better contrast colors, adapting to map palettes for clearer visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage colliders of vehicled and large enemies now properly match their rotation, ensuring accurate hit detection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tankette KV2 “Fortified Position” passive[/b] fixed, now works continuously as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor updated to be more visible and recognizable in all areas.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting me through Early Access. Your feedback is what helped shape this release. If you find something that feels unbalanced or notice an issue, don’t hesitate to share it with me.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Good luck out there, Raiders. Stay alive![/b][/p][p][/p][p]-Kemal[/p]

notes.title: Last Outpost Leaves Early Access on September 2!
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Last Outpost will fully release on September 2![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is a huge milestone for us and we can’t wait to share everything that’s coming. The full list of new content, features and improvements will be revealed in the official release post on September 2.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="LoHhmgXipdk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Even after full release, we’ll continue to [b]support Last Outpost[/b] and keep it in good shape.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your support during Early Access. The journey wouldn’t have been possible without you and we’re looking forward to stepping into this next chapter together.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Have fun and survive, Raiders![/b][/p]

notes.title: Performance Optimizations, Gameplay Balance and Bug Fixes (v0.8.0)
notes.notes: [h1]Hello Survivors[/h1][p]We meet again with another content update for [b]Last Outpost[/b]![/p][p]This patch focuses on huge performance improvements, bug fixes and gameplay balance adjustments to enhance your experience on the battlefield. Let’s dive into the details together![/p][p][/p][h2]Performance Improvements[/h2][p]Performance was improved by merging all props and environment meshes in Blender, then applying a Decimate modifier to reduce vertex count. This significantly lowered draw calls and improved batching while enhancing compatibility with the game's pixel art style.[/p][p]On the Unity side, occlusion culling was implemented to prevent rendering of off-screen objects more optimally and GPU instancing was applied to high-volume units to reduce CPU overhead during large-scale combats.[/p][p]Here’s some average data to show the impact of these optimizations in action:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/18387a55536460b5bc407eb6ebcc9d7ba89967a5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/b48708666fef5c2b4dae3376cd4e48fa47247adb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/2b4c521bcb867e6f523fd6b72a01fbf7f40d4ae5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/867ef350e3a6b2d8bbc758e96d1943f2e82578fb.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Balance[/h2][olist][*][p][b]Monowheel Spearman[/b] unit damage increased from [b]10 → 20[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ghost Rider[/b] skill's AoE area increased by [b]10%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flame Bunker HP[/b] increased from [b]400 → 600[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flame Bunker damage[/b] increased by [b]33%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Volt Guard Tower[/b] damage is now [b]area-of-effect[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Volt Guard Tower HP[/b] increased from [b]800 → 1200[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Car anti-air missile[/b] cooldown reduced by [b]50%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]wave and economy balancing[/b] on the [b]"Last Hope on a Dead Lake"[/b] level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some [b]building placements[/b] for better combat efficiency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Daytime speed[/b] increased by [b]20%[/b] to improve gameplay momentum.[/p][/*][*][p]Applied [b]power balancing[/b] tweaks to enemy wave compositions.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][olist][*][p]Fixed [b]unit revive bug[/b] where the [b]revive bar[/b] would freeze and never spawn the unit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the [b]Mob Info UI[/b] not displaying correctly when a wave contained a [b]Boss[/b] unit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Monowheel rotation bug[/b] and smoothed its movement. Previously, it would go underground at low FPS values weirdly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Monowheel range particle[/b] not showing properly during deployment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]immortal unit[/b] bug where some units wouldn't die properly. This rare bug could make the level unplayable under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]unit revive bug[/b] that caused revived units to behave incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]resource globes[/b] couldn’t be collected at [b]low FPS[/b], causing them to remain stuck.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]This update brings the game one step closer to full release. We're working hard on exciting new content, features and we have plenty of surprises waiting for you. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now. See you in the next update![/p][p][/p][p][b]Have fun and survive, Raiders![/b][/p]

notes.title: Content Update: New Vehicle: Monowheel! (v0.6.0)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Survivors[/h1]

[b]We meet again with a brand new content update for Last Outpost![/b]

An update with new vehicle, many passive and active skills, vehicle workshop upgrades and various bug fixes & balance improvements. Let’s dive into the details together!

[h2]Monowheel[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/4c9869a734be4e480ab53f3cf13e4934ba9ba695.png[/img]
We've introduced a unique new vehicle: The Monowheel. As the first melee vehicle in Last Outpost, it features frontal blades that let you slice through zombies up close. With a tight, responsive control scheme and a satisfying driving feel, Monowheel offers a fresh and thrilling gameplay experience. It also comes equipped with three unique movement-based skills that make full use of its agility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/4bb8afdde5fcf0435e5ab3b53dc73c72a57af245.png[/img]

[h3]Active Skills[/h3]

[list]
[*][b]Sharp Dash:[/b] Dashes in chosen direction with 50% increased blade damage.
[*][b]Drop Shock:[/b] Monowheel jumps with charged energy and crashes down quickly, dealing area damage.
[*][b]Torque Storm:[/b] Monowheel spins rapidly with rotors, dealing area damage for 3 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]Vehicle Workshop Upgrades[/h3]

[list]
[*][b]Throwing Spearman:[/b] Mounts a spearman on the rear of the Monowheel who automatically hurls spears at nearby enemies.
[*][b]Extended Fuel Tank:[/b] Increase the fuel capacity of the vehicle by 25%.
[*][b]Kinetic Field:[/b] Monowheel now generates a kinetic field that weakens incoming projectiles, reducing ranged damage taken.
[*][b]Metal Plates:[/b] Bolts thick metal plates to both sides of the Monowheel, increasing its base HP by 50%.
[/list]

[b]Here’s a quick look at the balancing & fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that required re-entering a building’s zone to upgrade it continuously. You can now upgrade directly without interruption.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with rotating objects when the game is paused.
[*] Fixed an audio bug affecting ambient sounds in the "Last Hope On A Dead Lake" level.
[*] Applied balance adjustments to the "Last Hope On A Dead Lake" level.
[*] Fixed resolution settings not working correctly on ultra-wide monitors.
[/list]

Feel free to share your feedback on the new content! If you noticed anything unbalanced or something didn’t feel right, let’s discuss it and improve it together!

That’s all for now. See you in the next update!

[b]Have fun and survive, Raiders![/b]

notes.title: Content Update: New Level and Movement System! (v0.5.0)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Survivors[/h1]

[b]We meet again with a brand new content update for Last Outpost![/b]

An update with new mechanics, new content, a brand new boss fight and various bug fixes & balance improvements. Let’s dive into the details together!

[h2]Last Hope on the Dead Lake[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/dafa169205823c574d2afedefc375098f4e18359.png[/img]

We've introduced a brand-new level. This time, we're defending one of the region's most critical water sources, though it's mostly dried up. Valuable mines are also located in the same area. Rival raider groups are trying to take over and drain what's left. We must defend it at all costs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/abf07dfe8c7f98bdec7cb4dbebab11c5d005e516.png[/img]

[h2]Movement System[/h2]

We've also been working on a new movement system, based on the feedback we received. The previous vehicle controls were too arcade and lacked realism. We've now reworked them to strike a balance; more realistic, yet still fun to drive over zombies!

[b]Here’s a quick look at the balancing & fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved the overall driving feel of vehicles.
[*] Balance adjustments in previous levels.
[*] Fixed minor translation and UI issues.
[*] Optimized performance during large-scale combat encounters.
[/list]

The journey to improve Last Outpost continues with more content, better balance and even more fun.

Feel free to share your feedback on the new content! If you noticed anything unbalanced or something didn’t feel right, let’s discuss it and improve it together!

That’s all for now. See you in the next update!

[b]Have fun and survive, Raiders![/b]

notes.title: Content Update: Leaderboards, Mutator System and more! (v0.4.0)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Survivors[/h1]

[b]We meet again with a brand new content update for Last Outpost![/b]

A major update with new challenge systems, leaderboard competition, a one-time tech tree progression reset and various bug fixes & balance improvements. Let’s dive into the details together!

[h2]Score and Mutator System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/7109e7ef809e4b7d436213e716f3e88489b4cfb8.png[/img]

We’ve introduced a brand-new scoring system to Last Outpost! After completing a level, you'll now see a detailed scoreboard featuring two key bonuses: one based on your remaining resources, and another tied to the active mutators you’ve chosen. The more daring your setup, the higher your potential score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/47dfcbe7c457bb1170025529dfdc95ec069800f5.png[/img]

This ties directly into the new Mutator System, which lets you customize the challenge when selecting your loadout. You can activate any combination of mutators, each with its own score multiplier. Want a higher score? Stack up those mutators but be warned, the difficulty will rise with every one you enable!(There’s even one mutator that makes the game easier but it comes with a score penalty!)

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/f602db5e3156e0fc651e53a374461af9165e0775.png[/img]

With the new leaderboard system, you can now track your progress and see how you rank against players worldwide. Whether you're aiming for global glory or a friendly competition with your buddies, the leaderboards let you showcase your skills and climb the ranks in Last Outpost. Challenge yourself, challenge your friends, and prove you're the best commander!

[h3]Tech Tree Reset Available![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/319943ff23aeda56dd317a4681fc41dd385fb454.png[/img]

We’ve also heard your feedback; many of you requested the ability to reset your tech tree progression and reclaim your research points. That’s why we’ve added a one-time tech tree reset option for each user.

During this long development process, many bugs have also been fixed based on player feedback, along with quality improvements.

[b]Here’s a quick look at the balancing & fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing resource orbs to stop or slow down during gameplay.
[*] Resolved a bug where the "Napalm Bombs Cooldown" tech progression wasn't saving correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where defense towers would hit once when ally units were instantiated.
[*] Adjusted enemy waves and the economy of the final level, "Ember Outpost," based on player feedback.
[*] Fixed minor translation and UI issues.
[/list]

The journey to improve Last Outpost continues with more content, better balance, and even more fun.

Feel free to share your feedback on the new content! If you noticed anything unbalanced or something didn’t feel right, let’s discuss it and improve it together!

That’s all for now. See you in the next update!

[b]Have fun and survive, Raiders![/b]

notes.title: Content Update: Units! (v0.1.0)

[h2]Hello Survivors,[/h2]

This is the first content update (a small one) for Last Outpost during Early Access. We’ve been gathering feedback and suggestions from both Steam and Discord and we’ve worked hard to incorporate them, alongside the regular content we had already planned.

Throughout this process, the focus will be on player experience and feedback. Feel free to share any ideas, suggestions or feedback with us. Now, let’s take a look at what's coming with this update!

[u]Here’s the new content:[/u]

[*] Our new melee unit, "Gauntlet-men," has arrived! They follow the same upgrade structure as other units.(3 sub classes)
[*] A new tech under Buildings, "Hold Position," is available to manage your units more effectively.
[*] Improved UI panel for units: You can now toggle melee, ranged and special unit bars.
[*] You can now double-click units to select all units of that type.
[*] Units can now teleport to the selected position, but only during the daytime :)
[*] Units now revive at the same point where they started that night.
[*] You can now set your FPS limit to any number you wish, in addition to V-Sync, due to performance issues.

[u]Bug Fixes:[/u]

[*] Fixed a localization bug in the Chinese language that caused text to display incorrectly (e.g., "口").
[*] Fixed a bug preventing units from moving close to buildings and added some QoL improvements.

Our [b]Roadmap[/b] will be announced in the coming days, stay tuned!

That’s all for now. See you on next update!

[b][i]Have fun![/i][/b]

notes.title: Small Update (0.0.2)
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Survivors,[/h2]

The release date is near, and we are grateful for your feedback so far. We have implemented many changes based on your input and right now, we’ve made a huge change on how Research Points (RPs) work. This adjustment ensures that if a level feels too challenging, you will have access to more RPs, more technologies and new maps at a faster pace.

During testing, we played through all maps using only the basic setup, without spending any RPs. It is entirely possible to succeed this way and we believe the game will feel easier once you fully grasp the mechanics. To keep things challenging, we are also introducing the Mutator system, allowing levels to become more difficult later on!

[u]Here are the latest changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Added a new UI explaining how to earn RPs.
[*] RPs are now awarded for: surviving each new night, completing the level with each vehicle, and surviving 10 nights.
[*] The next map will unlock after surviving 5 nights on the previous map.
[*] Rebalanced the costs of certain technologies in the Tech Tree.
[/list]

That’s all for now.

[i]Have fun!
Last Oupost Team[/i]

notes.title: Survive the Apocalypse with Major Updates on Last Outpost!
notes.notes:
I’ve thrilled to unveil a host of exciting updates that will elevate your experience in Last Outpost! Dive into a revamped gameplay experience with a brand-new tech tree progression system, unleash your creativity with customizable vehicle upgrades and gain a strategic edge with the introduction of the Recon Hub. Get ready to adapt your strategies and explore all the enhancements I’ve made to help you thrive in the zombie apocalypse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/fa263c366fe73d8599e5d2e1bd9e81031e199f22.png[/img]

[h1][b]Tech Tree Progression System[/b][/h1]

I’ve introduced an extensive tech tree to Last Outpost, designed to enhance your gameplay and provide meaningful progression. As you advance through the game, you’ll unlock powerful upgrades that significantly impact your strategy. This new system allows you to specialize in various paths, whether it’s enhancing your vehicles, fortifying your defenses or improving your unit capabilities.
With each decision you make, you’ll discover new content and abilities tailored to your play style. Experience the thrill of progression as you navigate the challenges of survival making every playthrough remain engaging and dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/eb02a5191ce2fe3563c1a639fff715ef678885ff.png[/img]

[h2][b]Vehicle Upgrade System & Customizable Vehicles[/b][/h2]

The Vehicle Workshop is now your go-to spot for upgrading and customizing your vehicles. Enhance your motorbike, car, and helicopter with new abilities and upgrades, tailoring them to fit your strategy. From increased speed to powerful new weapons and attachments. Your vehicles are now more versatile and deadlier than ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/91c2b15f82d86b52610ee1327a6772ca0de0204b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Recon Hub & Recon Drone[/b][/h3]

Introducing the Recon Hub, home to the all-new recon drone! This support unit gives you a tactical advantage on larger maps by providing extended vision. While using the drone’s view; you can control your units and activate skills from a distance making it a game-changer for exploring and strategizing in combat area!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995008/e56a7a10acb1f12acf22c05beb844f96b5f4841c.png[/img]

-Kemal
